scope: HM37 box blocks from hm37-hosted-control-stage through closure, their rollback/cleanup paths, and the carried site-05 control

facts.fact: /usr/local/bin/deno is a regular root-owned mode-0755 executable with a Deno 2 runtime compatible with the pinned harness.
The per-window DENO_DIR can be populated during staging and is complete enough for the later --cached control and cleanup-only runs without a network fetch.
facts.measure: sudo -n -i bash -c '. /home/commonswarm/stack/release-proofs/eb2a87ac4b5ae357ebc6f1ab45ed37fffaaa4922/window.env; d=/home/commonswarm/edge/controls/eb2a87ac4b5ae357ebc6f1ab45ed37fffaaa4922-${WINDOW_ID}/deno-cache; stat -c "type=%F owner=%U group=%G mode=%a" "$d"; find "$d" -xdev -type f -printf . | wc -c'

facts.fact: The root, commonswarm, caddy and ops users and their same-named groups exist; root can run commands as commonswarm without an interactive prompt.
facts.measure: getent passwd root commonswarm caddy ops && getent group root commonswarm caddy ops && sudo -n -u commonswarm true

facts.fact: Bash 5.2, Python 3, Docker with Compose, curl, GNU coreutils, findutils, grep, sed, awk and tar are installed with the GNU/Linux behavior used by the post-stage blocks.
facts.measure: bash --version | head -1; python3 --version; docker version --format '{{.Client.Version}} {{.Server.Version}}'; docker compose version; curl --version | head -1; stat --version | head -1; readlink --version | head -1; sha256sum --version | head -1; tar --version | head -1

facts.fact: The current, previous and candidate edge/stack releases, release proofs, window file and RELEASE_SHA files exist at the exact paths used by the plan with the expected ownership and directory modes.
facts.measure: for p in /home/commonswarm/edge/current /home/commonswarm/stack/current /home/commonswarm/edge/releases/72c57e0d76d0aa86fe4f811a2cf51499919fed20 /home/commonswarm/edge/releases/eb2a87ac4b5ae357ebc6f1ab45ed37fffaaa4922 /home/commonswarm/stack/releases/ad964ed158181ba1692dd05895f36fa7a1f87d3f /home/commonswarm/stack/releases/eb2a87ac4b5ae357ebc6f1ab45ed37fffaaa4922 /home/commonswarm/stack/release-proofs/eb2a87ac4b5ae357ebc6f1ab45ed37fffaaa4922; do stat -c '%N type=%F owner=%U group=%G mode=%a' "$p"; done

facts.fact: /home/commonswarm/.env is a root-protected regular file containing all exact-SHA required edge variable names, no test-hook names, and SWARM_SELF_SERVE=1.
facts.measure: stat -c 'type=%F owner=%U group=%G mode=%a' /home/commonswarm/.env; awk -F= '/^[[:space:]]*(export[[:space:]]+)?[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*=/{n=$1; sub(/^[[:space:]]*export[[:space:]]+/,"",n); gsub(/[[:space:]]/,"",n); print n}' /home/commonswarm/.env | LC_ALL=C sort -u

facts.fact: The OAuth runtime credential, service configuration and internal CA files exist with the expected names and provide host, optional port defaulting to 5432, database, least-privilege user, password and CA data.
facts.measure:
stat -c '%n type=%F owner=%U group=%G mode=%a' /etc/commonswarm-oauth/database-credentials /etc/commonswarm-oauth/service.env /etc/ssl/yulan-internal-ca.pem; python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib
print('database-credential-names=' + ','.join(sorted(json.loads(pathlib.Path('/etc/commonswarm-oauth/database-credentials').read_text()).keys())))
print('service-env-names=' + ','.join(sorted(line.split('=',1)[0] for line in pathlib.Path('/etc/commonswarm-oauth/service.env').read_text().splitlines() if line and not line.lstrip().startswith('#') and '=' in line)))
PY

facts.fact: The target-only migration environment file and database helper are present, root protected, and can reach the intended production database through the pinned PostgreSQL client image.
facts.measure: stat -c '%n type=%F owner=%U group=%G mode=%a' /etc/commonswarm-release/target.env /home/commonswarm/stack/current/deploy/supabase-stack/migrate/run-db-tool.sh; awk -F= '/^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*=/{print $1}' /etc/commonswarm-release/target.env; docker image inspect --format '{{.Id}}' postgres:17.6-bookworm

facts.fact: The backup status file has the expected schema and destination prefix, and the backup service can settle to inactive or failed within the release bound.
facts.measure:
systemctl show commonswarm-postgres-backup.service -p LoadState -p ActiveState -p Result --no-pager; stat -c 'type=%F owner=%U group=%G mode=%a' /var/backups/commonswarm-postgres/status.json; python3 - <<'PY'
import json
p='/var/backups/commonswarm-postgres/status.json'
d=json.load(open(p))
print('keys=' + ','.join(sorted(d)))
print('types=' + ','.join(f'{k}:{type(d[k]).__name__}' for k in sorted(d)))
PY

facts.fact: The edge recycle and PostgreSQL backup/restore timer units exist and are active at the points where the plan measures, stops or restores them.
facts.measure: systemctl show commonswarm-edge-recycle.timer commonswarm-postgres-backup.timer commonswarm-postgres-restore.timer -p Id -p LoadState -p ActiveState -p UnitFileState -p NextElapseUSecRealtime --no-pager

facts.fact: The named edge container exists and exposes health, 2 GiB memory, commonswarm-net network mode, exact Compose working-directory label and exact release-tree mount information.
facts.measure: docker inspect --format 'health={{if .State.Health}}{{.State.Health.Status}}{{end}} memory={{.HostConfig.Memory}} network={{.HostConfig.NetworkMode}} workdir={{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.working_dir"}} mounts={{range .Mounts}}{{.Source}}:{{.Destination}};{{end}}' commonswarm-edge-edge-runtime-1

facts.fact: The edge runtime listens on 127.0.0.1:9000 and serves the health, H0 and DARK/public-refusal response shapes required by the loopback blocks.
facts.measure: ss -ltn '( sport = :9000 )'; curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:9000/health; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w 'h0-note-status=%{http_code}\n' -H 'content-type: application/json' --data-binary '{"body":"release inventory probe"}' http://127.0.0.1:9000/functions/v1/h0/note

facts.fact: Cloudflare/public routing for edge-staging, API, MCP and site endpoints is reachable on HTTPS and returns the required media types and refusal/read shapes with the plan's User-Agent policy.
facts.measure: for u in https://edge-staging.commonswarm.com/functions/v1/h0/agent-doc/smoke https://api.commonswarm.com/functions/v1/h0/agent-doc/smoke https://mcp.commonswarm.com/.well-known/openid-configuration https://commonswarm.com/app; do curl -sS -o /dev/null -D - -H 'User-Agent: commonswarm-release-probe/1.0' "$u" | sed -n '1p;/^[Ss]erver:/p;/^[Cc][Ff]-[Rr]ay:/p;/^[Cc]ontent-[Tt]ype:/p'; done

facts.fact: The proof directory, explicit copy-back manifest and every required HM37 output are regular bounded files with root:root:0600 ownership before copy-back and exact-name closure.
facts.measure: sudo -n -i bash -c '. /home/commonswarm/stack/release-proofs/eb2a87ac4b5ae357ebc6f1ab45ed37fffaaa4922/window.env; p=/home/commonswarm/stack/release-proofs/eb2a87ac4b5ae357ebc6f1ab45ed37fffaaa4922; stat -c "%n type=%F owner=%U group=%G mode=%a size=%s" "$p" "$p/copy-back.list"; while IFS= read -r f; do stat -c "%n type=%F owner=%U group=%G mode=%a size=%s" "$p/$f"; done <"$p/copy-back.list"'

facts.fact: /srv/commonswarm/site/current resolves to a release directory with the expected identity, app/download documents and all referenced local assets readable by commonswarm.
facts.measure:
sudo -n -u commonswarm python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib, re
r=pathlib.Path('/srv/commonswarm/site/current').resolve(strict=True)
print('release=' + r.name)
for p in (r/'app/index.html', r/'download/index.html'):
 s=p.stat(); print(f'{p} mode={s.st_mode & 0o777:o} size={s.st_size}')
app=(r/'app/index.html').read_bytes()
for item in sorted(set(re.findall(rb'(?:src|href)="(/_astro/[^"]+\.(?:js|css))"', app))):
 p=(r/item.decode().lstrip('/')).resolve(strict=True); print(str(p))
PY
